scenes.vo: Welcome to Field O S. Here's how to run your sites from your phone, in three minutes.
Hi, I'm Mitra, your site buddy. Let me show you around.
First, your sites.

title: All your sites
in one list.
bullets: Today's brief in red when a site needs you
scenes.vo: Home shows all your sites. Ask Field O S sits at the top. The red card is today's brief: it tells you when a site needs you. Tap New project to add a site.
Next, the assistant.

title: Say it.
It's saved.
scenes.ask: Add ₹5,000 spent on cement at Kompally
scenes.reply: Sure, Ravi. Here it is for Kompally Villa.
scenes.card: Expense ₹5,000 for Material at Kompally Villa, Block B · cement
scenes.final: Saved ₹5,000 for cement at Kompally Villa.
scenes.vo: Type or speak what you need, in your own language. Field O S shows a card with what it will save. Nothing is saved until you tap Save.

title: Ask about
any site.
scenes.reply: 4 people punched in at Kompally Villa today: Ramesh, Suresh, Anil and Venkat. Lakshmi is absent.
scenes.vo: You can ask questions too. Who came to Kompally today? It answers from your own records.
Tasks and daily reports.

title: Know what's
running late.
bullets: Late tasks with a finish forecast
scenes.vo: The Tasks tab shows overall progress and every task. Late tasks are marked in red, with a forecast of when they will finish.

title: Speak the
day's work.
scenes.vo: In the D P R tab, tap Speak report and say what happened. Field O S writes the daily report, and you share it on WhatsApp.
Labour and wages.

title: Punch in
with GPS.
scenes.vo: Mark attendance with G P S in one tap per worker, including half days and overtime.

title: The wage sheet
adds itself up.
scenes.vo: On Saturday, the wage sheet shows what each worker earned, what was paid, and what is still due.
Money and material.

title: Money in,
money out.
scenes.vo: The Money tab shows what came in, what went out, and the balance, for every site.

title: Check stock
before you order.
scenes.vo: Stock shows what is left on site, so you order before work stops.

title: Who you owe,
oldest first.
scenes.vo: Who you owe lists every supplier you still have to pay, with the oldest debts first.
For the owner.

title: One brief
for every site.
scenes.vo: Every evening at seven thirty, the site brief shows each site's day, with the ones that need you first. Send it to WhatsApp in one tap.

title: Catch overspending
early.
scenes.vo: The dashboard compares every site's spending with its budget, and forecasts the cost to finish.

title: Approve from
anywhere.
scenes.vo: Purchases and budget overruns wait for your approval, wherever you are.
Last, take the tour.

title: Mitra shows you
one full day.
scenes.sub: Home, then the menu, then App tour.
scenes.vo: Mitra's two-minute tour walks you through one full day on a sample site. Find it on Home, or in the menu under App tour.

scenes.title: Start your free 3-day trial
scenes.vo: That's it. Start your free three-day trial today.
